createTicket.heading: Create ticket manually
createTicket.description: Use this when the automatic flow failed (misread plate, camera event with no matching ticket) and the entry needs to be recorded by hand.

unresolvedEvents.title: Unresolved camera events
unresolvedEvents.description: Camera events the automatic flow could not turn into a ticket (unreadable plate). Create the matching ticket by hand once you know which truck it was.

internalTrucks.title: Internal trucks
internalTrucks.description: Company-owned trucks with a pre-registered tare. A camera read for one of these plates closes the ticket from a single event — the leg that didn't fire uses the active conjunto's tare. A conjunto (rig/trailer type) can be shared by many trucks, each with its own tare.

truckDetail.heading: Truck {{plate}}
truckDetail.conjuntosDescription: Rig/trailer types already assigned to this truck, each with its own tare. Only one can be active at a time.
truckDetail.noConjuntos: No conjuntos assigned yet for this truck.
truckDetail.activateError: Couldn't activate this conjunto. Please try again.
truckDetail.assignConjuntoDescription: Pick an existing conjunto (shared across trucks) or create a new one, and set this truck's tare for it.
truckDetail.editPlateDescription: Fix a mistyped plate or update it after a plate change. Conjuntos and tares stay with this truck.

users.title: Users
users.description: Who can sign in to EixoLink. Administrators can use every screen; operators can only use the Operation screen. Users are deactivated, never deleted, so the audit trail keeps their name.
